purpose: Supplement registered after identifying the proposed endpoint-based evidence and before generating any new-direction sample. Probe texture-only exposures that create endpoints and real additive carriers on an observation with no endpoints.
clean_transforms: Use clip(0.5+1.35*(X-0.5),0,1) and clip(1.20*X+0.045,0,1) respectively as the transformed clean reference and identical observation. Both create real intensity endpoints without injected stripes.
matching: Use precisely the same phases, directions and amplitudes as in the full-range fixed_E and axis_y_E conditions. For the compressed reference all observations lie strictly within (0,1). Lower texture contrast also changes the signal-to-texture ratio.
scope: Report these four supplementary conditions separately from the sixteen new directions/strengths and three primary transformed clean controls.
